items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Where was that? Is that near where Odois is?

ctx.x: No, that was on the river uptown corner. They had strictly piano playing over there. That would go on day and night. That's where I first heard Steve and Manuel Moneta and Pete Marvin. They was on a party there one night. I was nothing but a kid that stole off and put on long pants to go around. And my brother taking me into the Hummin' Boy. And that's where Steve was playing. And later on my uncle Willie came in. He wasn't expecting to see me there, but since I was there, we made a jam section out of it. And he…
Where was that? Is that near where Odois is?
That's way up around the riverfront now. At Colton Avenue, the end of Colton Avenue, up in that section there.
